caption: The drawing depicts a long dress rendered in black ink on a light beige background. The dress has a high, fitted collar, long sleeves, and a floor-length skirt that flares outward from a cinched waist. The bodice features vertical paneling with decorative floral embroidery running down the center and along the seams. The sleeves are also adorned with similar floral embroidery that extends from the shoulder to the cuff, which is also embellished. The dress includes ruffled accents along the shoulders and the edges of the sleeves. The skirt is designed with multiple narrow pleats extending from the waist and is bordered by a wide band of floral embroidery at the hem. The floral patterns are composed of small, detailed linework. The drawing is labeled "East Majorie" in small, simple text near the lower left corner.
title: Dress
